disposition: retain as a provider-owned Codex builtin after correcting overwrite guidance and multi-install failure semantics
pack: skill-management (optional outside the Codex builtin set)
invocation: task-triggered for listing installable skills or explicitly installing from the curated collection or a GitHub repository

execution.recommended: direct read-only listing; one in-session install at a time after explicit source and destination authority
execution.alternatives: multi-skill installation only after complete preflight and atomic publish, or with explicit partial-result reporting; no delegation or Herdr by default

changes.summary: Add a full-tree review, source-specific overwrite and batch-safety proposals, execution alternatives, stable human decisions, validation evidence, and promotion boundaries while preserving all frozen provider bytes.

questions.question: Should the generic installer ever overwrite a provider-managed .system skill?
questions.recommendation: Do not overwrite system skills; route repair or upgrades to a separately authorized provider update mechanism.
questions.rationale: The current implementation refuses existing destinations, and generic overwrite would blur provider ownership and recovery authority.

questions.question: Should a multi-skill request be all-or-none?
questions.recommendation: Preflight and stage the complete batch, then publish only when every member passes.
questions.rationale: The current sequential copy loop can leave earlier skills installed while returning failure for a later member.

validation: Read all eight baseline files plus the added review notes; directly inspected both icon assets and both metadata links.
Parsed all three Python files with ast and parsed agents/openai.yaml plus SKILL.md frontmatter as YAML.

Executed isolated temporary fixtures with mocked repository and listing data and no network or live destination: URL parsing/list sorting passed, relative and ZIP traversal were rejected, and a missing second skill left the first copied while returning failure.
Static walkthroughs covered curated and experimental listing, public and private sources, destination collision, arbitrary-source trust, system-skill ownership, credentials, and batch failure.
limitations: Installed Codex tree has unknown upstream version and provider-owned update behavior.
No network request, Git command, credential access, live install, overwrite, or provider behavior test was performed.
Cross-harness destination, agents/openai.yaml, and next-turn availability behavior remain unverified.
The installer validates containment and basic layout, not remote source trust, signatures, semantic correctness, or later runtime safety.
Graph indexing excluded the SVG and PNG by suffix; both were inspected directly.
Authoring and verification were performed by the same reviewer.
